preview_chunks.text: 1 Purpose and scope / 目的和适用范围 1 Purpose and scope / 目的和适用范围 This CT QR shall be effective for SSME CT where the QMM [6] is applicable. 本程序适用于在质量管理手册 [6]适用范围内的 SSME CT。 It regulates the procedure for planning, R&D, management and further development of systems, sub-systems, system components and services and purchases included therein. It describes the general guidelines and typical requirements, which must be observed for all R&D projects. 本程序规定了对系统、子系统、系统 组件进行 计划、技术开发及管理/进一步开发的程序，维 修和采购也包含在内。 本指令还对所有技术开 发项目必须遵守的总方针以及典型需求作了说 明。 Depending on the particular project circumstances, these data can be adapted to requirements, as long as this does not run counter to the basic principle of the CT QR (tailoring is to be described in the QMP) 只要不违背质量保证程序基本原则， 本规定可以 根据项目的特殊情况进行修改以适合具体的需 求(调整和裁剪 – 在质量管理计划中描述)。 For technical advancements, for example, the formal M120 and M150 decisions may be omitted if all the required design input documents are present. 比如，对于进一步技术开发，只要提交所有所需 的设计输入文件，可以省略正式 M120 和 M150
